name: mhendric/Get-ClientsFromRPCClientAccessLogs
description: Parses the RPC Client Access logs of one or more Exchange 2010+ servers looking for a specific client operation type, and exports the found results to .CSV. Performs the search of each target computer in parallel. The target computers perform their log search locally, and then return the results to the machine where the script is executed from. This approach conserves memory on the script computer, and significantly speeds up the collection time.
